settings_language_help: Console display language. English is the default.
settings_appearance_help: Theme for the console. System follows your OS preference.
settings_live_refresh_help: How often live views (Overview, Domias, Conversations in live mode) poll for fresh data.
domia_kb_desc: Real facts about this deployment (floor, hours, nearby places). Domia answers from these offline — no tools or internet.
domia_kb_empty: No knowledge yet. Add facts Domia should know about its place and role.
domia_kb_content_placeholder: Checkout is at 11 AM. Late checkout until 2 PM at the front desk.
config_section_identity_desc: This Domia's name on the network — how it shows up everywhere in the console.
config_section_character_desc: Who this Domia is — character and the way it talks.
config_section_llm_desc: The language model that thinks and replies.
config_section_stt_desc: Speech-to-text — how it transcribes what it hears.
config_section_wakeword_desc: Wake word, microphone capture and voice activity.
config_section_playback_desc: How synthesized audio is played back.
config_section_capabilities_desc: Which parts of the pipeline this Domia runs locally.
config_section_modules_desc: Memory, emotion, identity and other cognitive modules.
config_section_skills_desc: Connect skill providers so this Domia can take real actions and fetch information. The first protocol is MCP (Model Context Protocol) — Home Assistant, a calendar, a filesystem, your own. Enable the Skills toggle in Behavior for the tools to be used.
config_section_mqtt_desc: Local MQTT broker for discovery and heartbeat.
config_section_advanced_desc: Session, memory window and concurrency tuning.
config_section_health_desc: Configured engines vs what is actually installed.
config_section_models_desc: Install and inspect models for every stage.
config_hint_domia_name: A human name for this device, e.g. Kitchen or Living Room.
config_hint_character_name: How the Domia refers to itself.
config_hint_voice: Voice within the model, e.g. af_heart.
config_hint_first_flush_cap: Flush the first phrase after this long even if short. 0 = off.
config_hint_pipeline_depth: Sentences buffered between LLM and TTS.
config_hint_eager_synthesis: Upcoming sentences synthesized while the current one plays. 0 = lazy.
config_hint_server_url: Where the model server runs. Ollama host (http://localhost:11434) or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (http://localhost:8080/v1 for llama.cpp / LM Studio / vLLM, or a cloud URL).
config_hint_api_key: Only for hosted/cloud OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Leave empty for local servers.
config_hint_reflection_model: Smaller model for off-hot-path reflection (emotions/facts) — keeps the main model's prompt cache warm. Empty = same model.
config_hint_reasoning_effort: How much the model is allowed to think before answering the voice turn. None keeps replies immediate and disables thinking on templates that support it.
config_hint_reflection_reasoning_effort: Reasoning effort for the off-hot-path reflection pass, which can afford to think more than the voice turn.
config_hint_skills_prompt_mode: When skills are on: lean = most reliable tool-calling, full = richest persona (needs a stronger model), compact = balanced.
config_hint_skills_routing: intent-gate runs a tiny model first so chit-chat keeps full persona and only real commands hit the tools; always-agent sends every turn through the tool path.
config_hint_intent_model: Small model for the intent gate (default llama3.2:3b). Only used when routing is intent-gate.
config_hint_agent_max_steps: Max tool-call iterations per turn before the agent gives up.
config_hint_flush_padding: Trailing silence appended before the final decode when a streaming session is flushed.
config_hint_min_silence: Silero's internal debounce — sustained silence before speech is considered over. Adds up with End of speech.
config_hint_end_of_speech: Extra confirmation AFTER Min silence elapses. Effective wait = Min silence + this — the most felt latency knob.
config_hint_follow_up_window: After replying, keep listening this long for a follow-up — no wake word needed. 0 turns it off.
config_hint_barge_in: Saying the wake word while it talks cuts the reply and listens.
config_hint_speculative_commit: Start thinking after this much raw silence, before end-of-speech confirms — cancelled silently if you keep talking. 0 turns it off.
config_hint_follow_up_lead_pad: Audio kept from just before follow-up speech was detected, so the first syllable isn't clipped.
config_hint_truncation_replay: If streamed playback exits before the audio finishes, replay the missing tail from the archived reply.
config_hint_truncation_replay_threshold: Only replay when more than this many milliseconds were cut off.
config_hint_feedback_sounds: Master switch for non-verbal cues (only on live mic turns).
config_hint_memory_recall_include_expire: Also recall facts that are no longer true, marked as former.
config_hint_memory_fact_max_age_days: Days after which inferred facts stop being recalled. Empty = never expire.
config_hint_skills_tools: Let this Domia call tools from connected skill providers (see the Skills section).
config_hint_builtin_tools: Let this Domia use its own native tools (time, timers, alarms, reminders, memory) and answer them without the language model. Turn off together with Skills for a pure speech-to-speech run.
config_hint_yield_to_voice: Abort and requeue reflection when a voice request arrives.
config_hint_heartbeat_signature_required: Drop mesh heartbeats that are not signed with the shared mesh secret.
config_hint_model_install_allowed_hosts: Only archives from these hosts (or their subdomains) can be installed through the model manager.
config_hint_warmup_on_boot: Preload STT/LLM/TTS after startup so the first turn is hot.
config_hint_peer_stale_after: Skip delegation targets not heard from in this window.
config_archetype_standalone_desc: Everything local — wake word, mic, STT, LLM, TTS and playback.
config_archetype_thin_client_desc: Wake word + audio only; delegates STT/LLM/TTS to a hub.
config_archetype_inference_hub_desc: Brain only — STT, LLM, TTS and intents, no mic or speaker.
config_template_editing_copy: Editing a copy — nothing is applied to a live Domia
config_applying_restarts: saving reloads only the affected subsystems of {name}, without a restart
config_skill_none: No skill providers yet. Add one to give this Domia tools — Home Assistant, a calendar, a filesystem, or any MCP server.
config_skill_token_hint: Write-only — leave blank to keep the current one.
config_skill_headers_hint: Write-only — leave blank to keep current.
config_skill_allowlist_hint: Tick the tools this provider may expose. Empty = expose every tool.
config_skill_advanced_hint: Adapter options as JSON. Keys this provider understands:
config_skill_advanced_hint_end: . Tool parameter trimming lives in the descriptor below, not here.
config_preset_home_assistant_desc: Control devices and read live state over MCP. Aliases, core tools and finalize are filled automatically.
config_preset_generic_mcp_desc: A plain MCP endpoint. Set the URL and any auth, then tweak the descriptor if needed.
config_preset_music_assistant_desc: Play and control music by voice over MCP. Ships the playback and volume tools; the music specialization handles search and speaker matching.
config_skill_preset_hint: Home Assistant fills aliases, core tools and finalize automatically — you usually only need the URL and token.
config_skill_music_hint: Mint the token in Music Assistant: Settings → Plugins → FastMCP Server → Connect Wizard. Enable the control_playback, control_volume, control_media and control_players permissions there, or playback and volume tools stay hidden.
models_custom_hint: Any model, no catalog edit. Spec:
models_no_catalog: No catalog entries for this stage.
chat_empty_hint: Type, toggle “Speak replies”, or upload a WAV to test any flow.
chat_live_channel_note: This is a live channel — every exchange is a real interaction, logged and visible in Conversations.
chat_placeholder_demo: Chat needs a live mesh — disabled in this read-only demo

broadcast_recent_empty: Announcements you send show up here.

broadcast_intercom_desc: Open a live voice link between two rooms on the same node.

err_node_unreachable: This node has no reachable address
err_target_unreachable: Target node has no reachable address

err_announce_empty: Type a message or record a clip

toast_template_saved_desc: Apply it to any Domia from Templates.
toast_identity_created_desc: {name} is now hosted live — no restart needed.
toast_identity_removed_desc: {name} was soft-disabled — its history and config are kept. You can re-add it later.
toast_wake_saved_reconnect: Wake word saved — applies on reconnect
toast_device_not_responding_desc: Bound, but it didn't connect. Check the encryption key and that the device is on the network.
toast_satellite_unbound_desc: Connection dropped live — no restart needed.

dlg_avatar_desc: Pick a character or upload your own image. Saved instantly — no restart.
dlg_restart_desc: The Domia process restarts and reloads its configuration from the database. It is briefly unavailable while it comes back.
dlg_save_template_desc: Captures this Domia's full configuration — persona, voice, engines, models, capabilities and tuning — minus device identity and network. Apply it to any Domia later.
dlg_add_identity_desc: Creates a new neutral identity hosted on this node. It comes online live — other identities stay up — then you can configure it.
dlg_remove_identity_desc: This soft-disables the identity on this node — its history and configuration are kept, and it stops responding live (no restart, other identities stay up). You can re-add it later.
dlg_bind_desc: Assign this device to a room. Paste the device's API encryption key (from its ESPHome setup). It connects live.
dlg_add_sat_desc: Pick the Domia this satellite belongs to, then discover a device on the network or add a LiveKit room.
sat_none_found: No Satellites devices found on the network.
sat_view_desc: Hardware endpoints connected to your Domia fleet.
sat_empty_hint: Discover and bind satellites from a Domia's page.
sat_select_prompt: Select a satellite to see details.
satset_desc: Timing this Domia uses when it talks to this device. Changes are saved on the node and applied live.
satset_offline: The device is offline — settings are read-only until it reconnects.
satset_follow_up_no_speech_hint: How long the device keeps listening after a reply before giving up on a follow-up.
satset_follow_up_request_max_hint: Maximum length of a follow-up request before it is cut off.
satset_playback_drain_margin_hint: Extra time allowed for the speaker to finish the last audio chunk.
satset_run_listening_max_hint: Maximum length of a single spoken request.
satset_capture_head_trim_hint: Audio dropped at the start of a capture to remove the wake word tail.
satset_streaming_tts_hint: Send speech to the device as it is generated instead of one finished file.
satset_media_player_hint: Name of the media player this device announces through. Leave empty to let the node choose.
satset_invalid: Values must be whole numbers of milliseconds, zero or more.
sat_timers_offline: The device is offline — timers are unavailable.
sat_timers_empty: No timer running on this device.
sat_timers_unavailable: This device does not accept timers right now.
agenda_desc: Timers, alarms and reminders this Domia is holding, and the state of its proactivity runtime.
agenda_offline: This Domia is offline — its agenda is unavailable.
agenda_status_error: Could not read the proactivity runtime
agenda_already_settled: That item had already fired or been cancelled.
agenda_not_found: That item is no longer on the node.
conv_incomplete_aborted_detail: It was interrupted — a barge-in or a newer turn started on this Domia (one conversation runs at a time), or it was cancelled. The captured audio is kept, but the turn did not complete, so some later stages (transcript, reply, or audio) may be missing.
conv_incomplete_aborted_detail_reason: It was interrupted ({reason}). The captured audio is kept, but the turn did not complete, so some later stages (transcript, reply, or audio) may be missing.
conv_incomplete_failed_detail: The pipeline hit an error before producing a reply.
conv_incomplete_empty_stt_detail: Speech-to-text produced no text — likely silence, a very short utterance, or an audio issue. Without a transcript the LLM and TTS stages don't run.
conv_incomplete_no_reply_detail: The model didn't return a response for this turn.

broadcast_original_desc_record: Record a clip to play it.

tpl_new_clone_domia: Or clone a Domia (offline ones use their last reported config)

domia_confirmations_gone: That confirmation is no longer waiting

conv_new_interaction_note: New interaction {id} — appears in Conversations after the next sync.

shell_error_desc: An unexpected error occurred while loading this view.
shell_not_found_desc: This page may have moved or never existed. Let’s get you back to the fleet.
tpl_edit_desc: Edit this template's configuration and save your changes.
conv_tool_runs_description: Every tool this turn dispatched, with the policy that let it through.
conv_tool_runs_empty: No tool ran on this turn.
conv_tool_runs_error: Could not read the tool runs from the node.
config_desc_kind_hint: Selects the built-in specialization that fills routing, hints and fast path on the node.
config_desc_param_allow_supersedes: Supersedes toolParamAllow in the advanced config above.
conv_timeline_empty: No turn events recorded for this interaction.
config_hint_fast_path: Deterministic grammar tier that executes simple commands without the LLM.
config_hint_fast_path_compound: Split "X and Y" commands on the language's conjunctions and run each target without the LLM when every part is an allowed action.
config_hint_agent_question_guard: When the utterance is a question, a write tool chosen by the model is retried with read-only tools once, then parked for confirmation.
config_hint_agent_target_guard: A write tool whose target (or any of its aliases) is not mentioned in the utterance is blocked and the reply says it could not be done. Prevents a small model from acting on the wrong device.
config_hint_agent_read_then_answer: On a question, once the model has read state it answers without another tool round.
config_hint_fast_path_min_coverage: Minimum literal coverage (0-1) a template match needs before it executes.
config_hint_agent_decision_mode: native = model tool-calling API; structured = constrained single-JSON decision.
config_hint_authored_speech: In structured mode, speak the model's own "say" text instead of a second finalize inference.
config_hint_agent_max_tool_calls: Hard cap on tool executions per turn.
config_hint_agent_budget: Total time budget for one agent turn. 0 disables the backstop.
config_hint_constrained_repair: Retry invalid tool arguments with schema-constrained decoding.
config_hint_intent_llm_single_slot: Off = 1-slot servers trust the matcher and skip the LLM intent fallback.
config_hint_slot_wait_timeout: How long a turn waits for a free LLM slot before failing.
config_hint_phrase_cache: Reuse rendered audio for repeated short phrases (finalize templates, confirmations).
config_hint_anaphora_max_age: How recent the last acted entity must be for "turn it off" style follow-ups.
config_skill_discover_none: No skill providers announced on this network.
skills_health_engine_off: Skills and built-in tools are off for this Domia.
bench_desc: Runs a few golden voice turns through the real pipeline and grades each stage against this hardware's thresholds.
config_secret_placeholder: Leave blank to keep the current value
config_secret_hint: Stored secrets are never shown. Enter a new value to replace it.
config_schema_loading: Loading the field catalog from the node…
config_schema_empty: This node exposes no configurable sections.
config_schema_snapshot_notice: Field catalog from the console's bundled snapshot — the node did not answer GET /config/schema. Fields added in a newer core may be missing until it comes back.
config_schema_failed_notice: Could not load the field catalog from the node; showing the bundled snapshot.
config_hint_emotion_expression_style: How much the current mood colours replies: minimal, balanced or talkative.
config_hint_voice_style: Free-text delivery hint injected in the persona prompt (e.g. "warm, unhurried").
config_hint_prompt_overrides: JSON object overriding individual persona prompt blocks. Leave empty to use the built-in prompt.
config_hint_quantization: Model weight precision variant to load (e.g. int8). Must match the installed files.
config_hint_espeak_data_path: Optional espeak-ng dictionary folder for out-of-vocabulary words.
config_hint_engine_config: Engine-specific JSON (voice packs, speaker ids, extra model files).
config_hint_pacer: Hold short sentences back until enough audio is queued, so playback never starves.
config_hint_worker_recycle_after_jobs: Restart an inference worker after this many jobs (0 = never). Guards against native memory growth.
config_hint_keep_alive: How long the LLM server keeps the model loaded after the last request.
config_hint_slot_affinity: Pin follow-up turns to the same server slot to reuse the KV cache.
config_hint_tool_model: Optional separate model for tool-calling turns. Empty = main model.
config_hint_matcher_engine: How utterances are matched to skills: lexical (BM25), semantic (embeddings) or hybrid (both, fused).
config_hint_embed_backend: Where embeddings are computed: in-process (transformers) or on the Ollama server.
config_hint_embedding_model: Used only when the embedding backend is Ollama.
config_hint_intent_lexical_min_score: When the embedding gate already says chat, only a keyword match scoring at least this much sends the sentence to the LLM classifier. Higher means fewer LLM calls; 0 escalates on any keyword match.
config_hint_descriptor_routing: Use skill descriptors (aliases, examples, keywords) to route utterances before the LLM.
config_hint_agent_ack_after: Speak a short acknowledgement if a tool turn is still running after this delay.
config_hint_confirmation_ttl: How long a pending "are you sure?" confirmation stays valid.
config_hint_tool_shortlist_max: Maximum tools offered to the model per turn.
config_hint_fast_path_blocklist: Skip the fast path for utterances that contain hedges or questions.
config_hint_async_follow_up_policy: What to do with a follow-up that arrives while an async tool is running: queue it or drop it.
config_hint_partial_at_endpoint: Emit the partial transcript as soon as the endpoint fires instead of waiting for the final decode.
config_hint_rule1_trailing_silence: Endpoint after this much silence when nothing was decoded yet.
config_hint_rule2_trailing_silence: Endpoint after this much silence once speech was decoded.
config_hint_rule3_min_utterance: Force an endpoint once an utterance reaches this length.
config_hint_turn_detector_engine: Acoustic end-of-turn model used when acoustic endpointing is on.
config_hint_acoustic_endpointing: Let the turn detector decide when you finished speaking, instead of fixed silence.
config_hint_semantic_endpointing: Ask the LLM whether the partial transcript looks complete before committing.
config_hint_endpoint_complete: Silence required after a transcript that looks complete.
config_hint_endpoint_incomplete: Silence required after a transcript that looks unfinished.
config_hint_dynamic_endpointing: Adapt the silence window to the speaker's pace between the min and max below.
config_hint_speculative_tts: Start synthesising a speculative reply before the endpoint is final.
config_hint_speculate_with_skills: Allow speculation on turns that may call a skill.
config_hint_satellite_speculation: Enable speculative commits for satellite turns too.
config_hint_pause_barge_in: Pause playback on a possible interruption instead of killing it; resume if it was a false alarm.
config_hint_false_interruption_timeout: How long to wait for speech after a pause before resuming playback.
config_hint_echo_suppress: Ignore barge-in candidates that line up with the Domia's own speech.
config_field_suppress_wake_peer_speaks: Suppress wake while a peer speaks
config_hint_suppress_wake_peer_speaks: Ignore the wake word while another Domia in the room is talking.
config_hint_shared_mic_stream: Share one microphone capture between wake word, VAD and recording.
config_hint_playback_pause: Allow playback to be paused and resumed (needed for pause-on-barge-in).
config_hint_word_level_heard: Track which words were actually heard so a cut reply is truncated precisely.
config_hint_environment_time: Inject the current date and time into the prompt.
config_hint_metrics_sample_resources: Record CPU/memory usage on each interaction trace.
config_hint_turn_events_persist: Store the per-turn event timeline the console shows in Conversations.
templates_secrets_note: Secrets (API keys, provider tokens, MQTT password) are never part of a template: the target keeps its own, and missing ones must be entered afterwards.
templates_secrets_short: Secrets are not included — the target keeps its own.
dlg_add_node_desc: Probe a Domia node by host and port. Its identities appear in the console right away, before the first heartbeat.
err_node_probe_unreachable: The node did not answer at that address.
err_node_probe_timeout: The node took too long to answer.
err_node_probe_unauthorized: The node rejected the console's mesh secret.
err_setup_candidates: Could not check for new nodes.
setup_description: Guided first run: name your Domia, pick a template, pair Home Assistant, add a satellite and verify.

setup_pick_empty: No hosted Domias found yet. Add a node by address or wait for a heartbeat.
setup_target_offline: This Domia is offline — steps that change its configuration are disabled until it comes back.
setup_banner_desc: Run the guided setup to name them, pick a template and pair your home.
setup_candidates_failed: Could not check for freshly installed nodes.
setup_name_desc: This is how it introduces itself and how it appears across the console.
setup_name_hint: Sets both the node name and the persona's name. You can refine the persona later in Configure.
setup_template_desc: A template sets engines, capabilities and behaviour in one go. You can tune everything afterwards.
setup_ha_desc: Discover the Home Assistant on your network, paste a long-lived access token and the skill provider is created and connected.
setup_ha_token_hint: Create the token in Home Assistant under your profile → Security. It is sent to the node once and never shown again.
setup_satellite_desc: Bind a Voice PE, ESPHome or Wyoming satellite so this Domia can listen from another room.
setup_verify_desc: Live checks against the node: health, identity, engines, skills and satellites.
setup_check_identity_missing: This identity is not hosted on the node.
config_hint_compute_provider: Inference backend of the sherpa build, e.g. cpu, cuda or coreml.
config_hint_bench_turns: How many turns each benchmark run drives.
config_hint_proactive_idle_nudge_enabled: Reach out after a period of silence.
config_hint_proactive_chime_enabled: Play a chime before a proactive nudge.
config_hint_proactive_critical_defer_max: How long a critical item waits for a quiet moment before it speaks anyway.
config_hint_voice_feel_autotune_enabled: Watch recent turns and recommend timing tweaks. Advisory only — it never changes settings on its own.
config_hint_voice_feel_window_turns: How many recent turns each recommendation is measured over.
config_hint_voice_feel_min_turns: Fewest turns in the window before a recommendation may be made.
config_hint_voice_feel_tick_ms: How often the autotuner looks at the window. It only runs while the Domia is idle.
config_hint_voice_feel_daily_budget: Most recommendations recorded in any 24 hours.
config_hint_voice_feel_cooldown_ms: How long a knob rests after a recommendation before it may be suggested again.
config_hint_voice_feel_rules: The rule table the autotuner evaluates: condition, target knob, step and bounds.
config_hint_phrase_cache_reply_units_ena: Cache recurring reply fragments, not just fixed phrases.
config_hint_phrase_cache_voice_step: Grid that mood drift snaps to before it becomes a cache key. Bigger steps mean more cache hits, less prosody detail.
config_hint_tts_prewarm_on_boot: Synthesise a throwaway phrase at startup so the first real reply is not slowed by a cold model.
config_field_tts_prewarm_on_reload: Warm voice after a config change
config_hint_tts_prewarm_on_reload: Warm the voice again whenever a config change reloads the engine, instead of waiting for the next reply.
config_hint_tts_prewarm_passes: How many warm-up syntheses each voice worker runs. More passes settle the engine further at the cost of a slower boot.
config_hint_intent_cache_enabled: Reuse a previous skill-or-chat decision when the same request comes back, so the routing gate is skipped.
config_hint_intent_cache_size: How many routing decisions are remembered. The oldest entry is dropped once the cache is full.
config_hint_intent_cache_min_similarity: How close a new request must be to a remembered one to reuse its decision. Lower values reuse more and risk the wrong route.
config_hint_vad_prewarm_on_boot: Load the speech detector at startup so the first wake word is not slowed by a cold model.
config_hint_heard_silence_trim: Ignore trailing silence when working out what was actually heard, so an interrupted reply resumes at the last spoken word. Needs word-level heard tracking.
config_hint_heard_silence_rms: Loudness below which audio counts as silence for that trim. Raise it if quiet tails are still counted as heard.
config_hint_two_tier_endpoint_enabled: Eagerly prefill on a fast first guess, confirm on the second.
config_hint_two_tier_settle_max_wait_ms: How long the final decode waits for an in-flight prefill before giving up and decoding cold.
config_hint_speculation_max_attempts: How many speculative decodes one turn may start before it waits for the final transcript.
config_hint_speculation_max_utterance_ms: Utterances longer than this stop speculating and wait for the final transcript.
config_hint_aec_enabled: Cancel speaker audio from the mic so barge-in works while speaking.
config_hint_denoise_enabled: Run a neural denoiser on mic input.
config_hint_echo_residual_gate_enabled: Suppress leftover echo the AEC did not remove.
config_hint_echo_reference_seconds: How much recent playback audio is kept to compare against the mic.
config_hint_echo_live_speech_ttl_ms: How long a wake word still counts as real speech after the gate last heard a live voice.
config_hint_stop_word_abort_enabled: Cancel the reply when the user says a stop word.
config_hint_stop_word_max_extra_words: Extra words allowed around a stop phrase before it stops counting as one.
config_hint_wake_verifier: Second-stage check that rejects false wakes.
config_hint_wake_verifier_max_ms: If the verifier takes longer than this, the wake is accepted anyway.
skills_health_trust_untrusted_help: Untrusted: only risk-increasing annotations from this provider are honored. A tool it marks as safe is still treated as destructive and asks first.
skills_health_trust_standard_help: Standard: only risk-increasing annotations from this provider are honored. An unannotated tool is still treated as destructive and asks first.
skills_health_trust_trusted_help: Trusted: every annotation from this provider is honored. Reads and additive writes run silently; destructive tools still ask first.
skills_health_trust_descriptor_note: Descriptor overrides always win over the tier.
skills_health_from_descriptor_help: This policy comes from the provider's descriptor override, not from the trust tier and annotations.
node_cfg_description: These settings govern the machine, not an identity. They are shared by every identity hosted on this node and never travel in a config bundle or a template.
node_cfg_no_anchor: This node has no hosted identity to reach it through.
node_cfg_save_failed: Could not apply the node configuration
node_cfg_mesh_tolerance_hint: How far an MQTT control envelope's timestamp may drift before the message is dropped as stale.
node_cfg_mesh_drop_warn_hint: How long repeated mesh drop warnings are collapsed into one summary line.
node_cfg_model_timeout_hint: Abort a model download or archive listing after this long. Staging cleanup uses twice this value.
node_cfg_model_max_bytes_hint: Largest single model download this node accepts.
node_cfg_model_redirects_hint: Redirect hops allowed while downloading a model.
node_cfg_model_jobs_hint: Model installs allowed to run at the same time on this node.
node_cfg_job_retention_hint: How long a finished install job stays listable before it is pruned.
node_cfg_public_audio_hint: Base URL announced in /audio links when this node sits behind a reverse proxy. Leave empty to use the node's own address.
vf_desc: Suggestions the autotuner derives from recent voice turns. Nothing changes until you apply one.
vf_failed: Tuning suggestions could not be loaded.
vf_empty: No suggestions yet — keep talking and the autotuner will propose one.
vf_empty_disabled: Turn the autotuner on in this Domia's configuration to collect suggestions.
vf_confirm_desc: {knob} will change from {from} to {to} on this Domia, live and without a restart.
err_read_node_config: Could not read the node configuration
err_apply_node_config: Could not apply the node configuration
vf_action_failed: The change could not be made.
config_skill_builtin_hint: Built into Domia — the time, the date, timers, alarms, reminders, repeat, dismiss, volume and remember/forget. Edit its phrasings and tool allow-list below; the provider itself always exists and cannot be removed.
health_llm_slots_hint: Counters since this node booted — how often identities waited for or were moved between LLM slots.
health_llm_slot_background_on_shared: Background work on a shared slot
skills_engine_off_mcp: Skills engine off — providers stay configured, but no tool runs this turn.
skills_builtin_off: Built-in tools off — the time, timers, alarms and reminders are unavailable.
skills_tool_hidden_help: The descriptor hides this tool from the model; it stays callable by name from a routine or the fast path.
skills_server_descriptor_hint: Shipped by the MCP server itself. Read-only here — Domia strips the policy fields before using it.
chat_live_mic_denied: Microphone access was denied — allow it in the browser to talk.
chat_live_unsupported: This browser cannot capture microphone audio.
chat_live_token_failed: Could not get a live voice token from this Domia.
config_hint_preset_name: Names this settings preset in the node's database. It is not the Domia's name.
sat_targets_error: Could not load the Domia list — adding a satellite is unavailable.
mem_domias_error: Could not load the Domia filter.
mem_evidence_error: Could not load the evidence for this fact.
mem_evidence_empty: No conversations are linked to this fact yet.
mem_episode_no_summary: No summary was written for this episode.
mem_episodes_load_failed: Couldn't load episodes — check the console connection.
mem_episodes_empty_hint: No episodes recorded yet. They appear once a conversation session is summarised.
mem_user_model_load_failed: Could not load what your Domias know about you.
mem_user_model_empty_hint: No Domia has built a picture of you yet. It grows as you talk.
templates_targets_error: Could not load Domias — applying a template is unavailable.
apply_state_title: Some settings are not running yet
apply_state_hint: This Domia kept the previous revision for the subsystems below. Fix the cause and save again, or restart the node.
desc_fast_path_hint: Phrases matched before the model runs. Each intent maps templates to one tool of this provider.
desc_hidden_tools_hint: Hidden from the model, still callable by name from a routine or the fast path.
routine_offline_note: This Domia is offline. Routines are read-only until it comes back.
routine_list_desc: A phrase this Domia answers by running a fixed list of tool steps, with no model in the loop.
routine_empty: No routines yet. Create one to give this Domia a phrase it answers instantly.
routine_toast_created: Routine created — the tool {tool} is live
routine_editor_desc: Phrases match what is spoken, steps are the tools run in order, and the reply is what this Domia says back.
routine_slug_invalid: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only, up to 40 characters.
routine_description_placeholder: Turns off the lights and says good night.
routine_description_hint: The model reads this description when it picks tools, so describe what the routine does.
routine_issue_phrases: Add at least one phrase in {locale}.
routine_issue_slot_kind: Routines cannot use context or schema-enum slots.
routine_phrases_desc: One phrase per line. Square brackets mark optional words, parentheses with a pipe mark alternatives, and braces mark a slot.
routine_slots_desc: A slot captures part of the phrase and passes it to the step arguments.
routine_slots_empty: No slots. The phrases are matched literally.
routine_slot_schema_arg: Argument whose schema lists the values
routine_slot_clock_note: Matches a spoken clock time such as 7:30 — nothing to configure.
routine_steps_desc: Tools run in order, up to {max} steps. A step that fails stops the routine.
routine_steps_tools_error: Tool list unavailable ({error}) — type the tool name instead.
routine_step_slots_hint: Write a slot name in braces as an argument value to fill it from the phrase.
routine_try_desc: Runs the fast path on this Domia without executing anything.
routine_try_miss_disabled: the fast path is off for this Domia
routine_try_miss_no_index: this Domia has no fast-path index yet
routine_try_miss_too_long: the phrase is longer than the fast-path limit
routine_try_miss_blocked_token: the phrase contains a blocked word
routine_try_miss_ambiguous: several routines or intents matched equally well
routine_try_miss_unavailable: the matching tool is not available right now
topology_presence_unavailable: Presence unavailable — no node answered, so live activity is not shown.
broadcast_presence_unavailable: Presence unavailable — no node answered, so broadcast targets can't be resolved.
lat_panel_description: Read live from the node right now — nothing here is stored by the console.
lat_live_description: Latency percentiles and speculation counters asked of a node directly.
lat_targets_error: Could not load the Domia list
lat_offline: This node is offline, so it cannot report live metrics.
lat_no_samples: This node has no completed turns to measure yet.
lat_sample_window: Percentiles over the last {count} completed turns (the node keeps a window of {window}).
lat_since_boot: Counters accumulate since the node process started and reset when it restarts.
lat_by_satellite_hint: Time to first audio, split by the satellite that carried the turn.
lat_ratio_speculation_hint: Share of speculative replies thrown away instead of handed to the user.
lat_ratio_speculation_detail: {handedOff} handed off · {discarded} discarded · {wasted} wasted first units
lat_ratio_barge_in_hint: Share of interruptions resumed instead of escalated to a full restart.
lat_ratio_two_tier_hint: Share of prefills reused by the final prompt instead of re-prefilled.
lat_ratio_wake_verifier_hint: Share of wake-word hits the verifier rejected as false.
ledger_live_error: The node did not answer — showing the archived copy.
ledger_ladder_unavailable: This turn recorded fewer than two ladder timestamps, so no ladder can be drawn. Text turns never fill it.
ledger_heard_hint: The dimmed tail was generated but never reached the speaker.
fastpath_tools_loading: Loading the tools this node reports…
fastpath_tools_error: Tool list unavailable ({error}) — edit the names as text.
fastpath_tools_none: This node reports no tools for this provider — edit the names as text.
fastpath_tools_stale: Kept, but not reported by the node right now
fastpath_tools_filtered_note: While an allow-list is set the node advertises only these tools, so the rest are not listed here. Clear the list to see every tool again.
fastpath_templates_hint: One per line. Slots go in braces, expansion rules in <angle brackets>, optional words in [square brackets], alternatives as (a|b).
fastpath_required_keywords_hint: Every group must appear in the phrase; the terms inside a group are alternatives.
fastpath_priority_hint: Higher wins when two intents match the phrase equally well.
fastpath_allow_blocked_hint: Match even when the phrase contains a blocked word.
fastpath_expansion_rules_hint: <name> inside a template expands to this pattern.
desc_limits_hint: The node enforces these on descriptors shipped by an MCP server. Yours are not rejected for going over, but staying inside keeps them portable.
desc_limits_offline: Node limits unavailable — showing the built-in defaults.
desc_invalid_title: The node will not accept this descriptor
desc_intents_dropped: {count} incomplete fast-path intents are dropped on save — each one needs a tool and at least one template.
desc_server_strips: These fields are yours alone: a server shipping its own descriptor at {uri} has them stripped —
desc_server_rejects: and such a descriptor is rejected outright when it uses
stream_incomplete: The reply stream ended before the turn finished.
stream_unreachable: Could not reach the streaming channel.
deleg_hint: Send a stage to another Domia instead of running it here. Lowest priority wins; the target must be reachable on the mesh.
deleg_empty: No delegations — every enabled capability runs on this Domia.
deleg_no_targets: No other Domia is registered yet, so there is nothing to delegate to.
deleg_target_unknown: Currently {key} — not in this console's registry.
deleg_targets_error: Could not load the Domias available as delegation targets.
mesh_rotate_help: While a rotation is in progress the node accepts both the current and the next secret. End the grace window once every node and satellite carries the new one.
mesh_rotate_failed: Could not change the rotation state
mesh_rotate_status_error: Could not read the mesh secret posture from this node.
mesh_rotate_nodes_error: Could not load the node list.
mesh_rotate_403_hint: Reading the posture works with any mesh bearer. Restarting or ending the grace window needs the node's signing secret or a request from the node itself, so a remote console is answered with 403.
mesh_rotate_403_seen: The node refused the change (403): this console is not using the signing secret. Run the action on the node, or point the console at the signing secret.
config_hint_mesh_secret_grace: How long a rotated mesh secret keeps accepting the previous one. Change it here, then drive the rotation from Settings.
admin_danger_reset_hint: Drops the in-memory session and the recent-turns window. Facts, knowledge and traces are kept.
admin_danger_erase_hint: Permanently deletes traces, facts, memories, emotion history, knowledge and archived audio for this identity. The configuration is kept.
admin_danger_erase_confirm_desc: This cannot be undone. Everything {name} has learned and recorded is deleted on the node.
admin_danger_offline_hint: This Domia is offline — both actions need the node to answer.
identity_restored_desc: {name} was retired and is live again as {key}.
identity_key_hint: Leave empty to derive it from the name. Give an exact key to restore a retired identity; an active one is rejected.
identity_key_invalid: Use letters, digits and underscores only
identity_renamed_desc: It now shows up as {name} everywhere.
modelspec_err_safe_name: must be a plain name (no path separators)
modelspec_err_sha256: must be a sha256 hex digest
modelspec_err_invalid: The node would reject this install spec
chat_satellite_hint: Play the reply on a bound satellite instead of the console
chat_reset_marker: Conversation reset — earlier turns are no longer in Domia's context
mind_export_hint: Download this Domia's live state as a portable bundle. Secrets are never exported — provider credentials are entered again on the target.
mind_export_offline_hint: This Domia is offline — the node has to answer to build a bundle.
mind_import_title: Import a mind into this Domia
mind_import_hint: Upload a bundle exported from another Domia. Provider credentials never travel in a bundle and have to be entered here.
mind_import_invalid_file: This file is not a Domia mind bundle
mind_import_replace_warning: Replace deletes the selected sections on {name} before applying the bundle.
mind_import_confirm_desc: The bundle from {source} is applied to {name} on the node. This cannot be undone.
mind_import_fk_note: {count} foreign-key issues were already on this node before the import.
mind_template_desc: Stores the bundle's character profile and emotion baseline as a console template you can apply to any Domia.
mind_template_no_persona: This bundle carries no character profile, so it cannot become a template.
routine_issue_arg_duplicate: Step argument keys must be unique
routine_delete_desc: "{name}" will be removed and {tool} will disappear from the fast path. This cannot be undone.
err_mesh_rotate_forbidden: The node refused the rotation: the mesh secret in use is not allowed to rotate
desc_provider_stdio_hint: stdio launches a local process: set command, commandArgs and commandEnv in the advanced config below. It requires the trusted tier, and the endpoint URL is ignored.
